articles.title: Delhi Horror: Husband Allegedly Shoots Wife Dead After Heated Argument, Flees Scene
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 33-year-old woman was allegedly shot dead by her husband following a domestic dispute in south Delhi's Sangam Vihar area on Thursday night. The accused fled the scene after the incident, and police have launched a search to trace him.

body.html:
A 33-year-old woman was allegedly shot dead by her husband following a domestic dispute in south Delhi's Sangam Vihar area on Thursday night. The accused fled the scene after the incident, and police have launched a search to trace him.

The victim, identified as Kavita, lived with her husband, Shubham Rajput, in K-2 Block near Amrita Public School in Sangam Vihar. According to police, the couple had been married for around one-and-a-half years.

Police said the couple had been facing financial difficulties, leading to frequent arguments. On Thursday evening, another altercation reportedly broke out after Shubham returned home from work. During the argument, he allegedly pulled out a pistol and fired two to three rounds at Kavita, killing her on the spot.

The victim's family has alleged that Shubham was involved in an extramarital relationship, which had become a recurring source of conflict between the couple. They also claimed that he frequently threatened to kill her. The family further alleged that the accused was involved in betting activities. Police said all these claims are being verified as part of the investigation.

After hearing gunshots, local residents alerted the police. A team from Tigri Police Station, along with forensic experts and crime scene investigators, reached the spot and examined the scene. Police recovered two to three empty cartridge cases, which have been sent for forensic examination, while the victim's body has been sent for post-mortem.

A murder case has been registered, and police are conducting raids to trace the absconding accused. Investigators are also probing how he obtained the firearm and whether there were any other motives behind the killing.

#Delhi #SangamVihar #Murder #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Anganwadi Worker Accused of Brutally Assaulting Toddler in Panvel
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking video allegedly showing an Anganwadi worker brutally assaulting a young girl at an Anganwadi centre in Nandgaon village, Panvel, has gone viral, triggering widespread outrage and concern among parents.

body.html:
A shocking video allegedly showing an Anganwadi worker brutally assaulting a young girl at an Anganwadi centre in Nandgaon village, Panvel, has gone viral, triggering widespread outrage and concern among parents.

The disturbing footage purportedly shows the worker placing her foot on the child's chest and kicking her while the toddler cries helplessly inside the government-run childcare centre.

Following the video's circulation on social media, the Navi Mumbai Police registered a case and launched an investigation into the incident. Police are also verifying the authenticity of the footage and examining the role of the Anganwadi management.

Senior officials said statements are being recorded, and child safety teams have been sent to the Nandgaon Anganwadi centre to ensure the safety of other children enrolled there.

The incident has sparked protests from local residents and parents, who are demanding the immediate arrest of the accused and strict action against those responsible.

Child rights activists have also called for systemic reforms, including mandatory CCTV surveillance in Anganwadi centres, psychological screening of childcare staff, and stricter monitoring mechanisms to prevent such incidents.

Authorities have urged the public not to circulate the video further in order to protect the identity and privacy of the minor victim, assuring that appropriate legal action will be taken.

#Panvel #NaviMumbai #Anganwadi #ChildAbuse #BreakingNews

articles.title: Who Are You to Check Me?' Drunk Woman Allegedly Assaults Woman PSI During Traffic Check, Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman was arrested after allegedly assaulting a woman Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) and creating a ruckus during a late-night drink-and-drive check on Shamanur Road in Davangere, Karnataka.

body.html:
A woman was arrested after allegedly assaulting a woman Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) and creating a ruckus during a late-night drink-and-drive check on Shamanur Road in Davangere, Karnataka.

The incident took place around 11.30 pm on Thursday near Bindas Bar, where PSI Shakuntala and her team from the Davangere South Traffic Police Station were conducting checks for drunk driving.

According to the police, the accused, identified as Preethi, was driving a black Mahindra Thar SUV rashly and was found to be heavily intoxicated after being stopped for inspection. When PSI Shakuntala attempted to conduct an alcometer test, Preethi allegedly shouted, "Who are you to check me?", pushed the alcometer from the officer's hand, and struck the PSI in the stomach. Police also alleged that she abused the officers with foul language, behaved indecently, and obstructed them from performing their official duty.

Videos of the altercation, recorded by locals and police personnel, have gone viral on social media. The accused was arrested and sent to judicial custody.

A case has been registered at Vidyanagar Police Station under Sections 121(1), 132, and 352 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. Further investigation is underway.

#Karnataka #Davangere #DrinkAndDrive #DrunkDriving

articles.title: Rajasthan Woman Constable Suspended After Photo Showing Feet on Desk During Elderly Man's Complaint
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman constable in Rajasthan has been suspended after a photograph showing her sitting with both feet resting on a desk while an elderly man waited to lodge a complaint at a police station went viral on social media.

body.html:
A woman constable in Rajasthan has been suspended after a photograph showing her sitting with both feet resting on a desk while an elderly man waited to lodge a complaint at a police station went viral on social media.

The incident took place at the Bichhiwara Police Station in Dungarpur district, where the elderly man had reportedly gone to file a complaint.

According to reports circulating on social media, the constable appeared uninterested in addressing the man's grievance. The viral photograph showed her sitting with both feet on the desk in the presence of the elderly complainant, a posture that drew widespread criticism online as unprofessional and disrespectful.

The image, reportedly clicked by someone at the police station, was widely shared across social media platforms, triggering massive public outrage.

Taking cognisance of the viral post, Dungarpur Police announced that the constable had been suspended with immediate effect. In its response to one of the posts, the police also confirmed that disciplinary proceedings had been initiated against her.

The incident once again highlighted the impact of social media, where a single viral image can quickly draw public attention and prompt official action.

articles.title: Sand-Laden Tractor Turns Death Trap: 2 Killed, 6 Injured After Crushing CNG Auto
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two people were killed and six others sustained injuries after a sand-laden tractor reportedly lost control and collided with a CNG auto-rickshaw in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district near Sailerha West in the Manjhanpur area on 24 June 2026.

body.html:
Two people were killed and six others sustained injuries after a sand-laden tractor reportedly lost control and collided with a CNG auto-rickshaw in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district near Sailerha West in the Manjhanpur area on 24 June 2026.

According to officials, the tractor suddenly turned and rammed into the CNG auto, causing a powerful impact that left the vehicle severely damaged. All the deceased and injured were travelling in the auto-rickshaw at the time of the accident.

The injured were rushed to the district hospital for treatment. Their condition is yet to be ascertained.

Police reached the spot soon after the incident and launched an investigation into the circumstances that led to the collision.

Further details are awaited.

#RoadAccident #BreakingNews #TractorAccident #CNGAuto

articles.title: Lohagad Murder Case: Police Say Fiancée, Lover Planned Killing at Pune Café a Day Before Trek
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Fresh details have emerged in the sensational Lohagad Fort murder case, with investigators claiming that the alleged conspiracy to kill 26-year-old Ketan Agarwal was finalised at a café in Pune's Kondhwa area a day before the incident.

body.html:
Fresh details have emerged in the sensational Lohagad Fort murder case, with investigators claiming that the alleged conspiracy to kill 26-year-old Ketan Agarwal was finalised at a café in Pune's Kondhwa area a day before the incident.

According to police, accused Siya Goyal and her alleged lover, Chetan Chaudhary, met at the café on the evening of June 17 and allegedly planned every aspect of the murder.

Investigators believe the duo discussed the use of code words, identified vulnerable locations at Lohagad Fort from where Agarwal could allegedly be pushed into a gorge, and coordinated their movements during the trek.

The latest revelations come as police continue to examine CCTV footage and other evidence collected during the investigation.

Speaking on the case, Senior Police Inspector Dinesh Tayde said the incident was initially registered as an accidental death after Ketan Agarwal fell from a height at Lohagad Fort on June 18.

"Initially, when this incident occurred on June 18, it was registered as an accidental death. However, when we conducted a detailed investigation, we found that the accused had premeditated the murder. Accordingly, we registered an offence and arrested both accused," Tayde said.

Siya Goyal and Chetan Chaudhary were arrested and later produced before a court, which remanded them to police custody until June 29.

Police said CCTV footage played a crucial role in uncovering the alleged conspiracy. Investigators claim that Chaudhary attempted to conceal his identity by wearing a hoodie, covering his face and deliberately avoiding looking towards surveillance cameras.

"The second accused in the CCTV, Chetan Chaudhary, was trying his best to conceal his identity. He was wearing a hoodie, covering his entire face and was not looking at the camera even once," Tayde said.

Investigators also claim the accused used pre-arranged signals to communicate during the trek.

"They were giving signals to each other as to when to stop and when to walk," the officer added.

According to police, both accused admitted to certain aspects of the investigation during questioning, although investigators have not disclosed further details.

Police are continuing to probe the exact sequence of events leading to Agarwal's death, collect forensic evidence and establish the full extent of the alleged conspiracy.

The case has drawn widespread attention due to the chilling allegations and the emerging details surrounding the alleged premeditated murder.

#LohagadFort #Pune #MurderCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Constable Suspended, Probe Ordered Into Woman Constable's Role
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A constable posted at Orai Kotwali police station in Uttar Pradesh's Jalaun district has been suspended after CCTV footage allegedly showing him engaged in inappropriate conduct with a trainee woman constable inside the police station's control room went viral on social media.

body.html:
A constable posted at Orai Kotwali police station in Uttar Pradesh's Jalaun district has been suspended after CCTV footage allegedly showing him engaged in inappropriate conduct with a trainee woman constable inside the police station's control room went viral on social media.

According to officials, the incident took place on Wednesday night inside the CCTV-monitored control room of Orai police station.

The viral footage, reportedly over two minutes long, allegedly shows constable Arvind Patel, a 2018-batch policeman who was on night duty, engaged in inappropriate conduct with a trainee woman constable while inside the police station.

The video later came to the attention of senior police officials, triggering widespread criticism and prompting immediate departmental action.

Superintendent of Police (SP) Vinay Kumar Singh ordered a preliminary inquiry and suspended Arvind Patel with immediate effect.

A departmental inquiry has also been initiated against the trainee woman constable. Circle Officer Rajesh Verma has been assigned to investigate the incident.

Police said further action against the trainee constable will be taken based on the findings of the inquiry.

SP Vinay Kumar Singh said maintaining discipline within the police force is of utmost importance and that any act of misconduct or indiscipline during duty hours would be dealt with strictly.

Officials said a detailed departmental investigation is underway to ascertain the circumstances surrounding the incident and determine any further disciplinary action.

#UttarPradesh #Jalaun #Orai #PoliceStation #ViralVideo

articles.title: 5 Family Members Drown in Kavery While Trying to Save Each Other
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A family pilgrimage ended in tragedy after five people, including four women from the same family, drowned in the Cauvery River near Muthathi in Karnataka's Mandya district on Wednesday evening.

body.html:
A family pilgrimage ended in tragedy after five people, including four women from the same family, drowned in the Cauvery River near Muthathi in Karnataka's Mandya district on Wednesday evening.

The victims were identified as Chaitra (20), Shwetha (38), Vijayamma (50), Priyanka (28), and Mahesh, the driver of the rented vehicle in which the family had travelled. The victims were natives of Channapatna and residents of Bengaluru's Byadarahalli area.

According to police, six family members, along with a four-year-old child, had travelled to Mandya district on a pilgrimage. The group first visited the Kabbalamma Temple and later reached the Muthathiraya Temple at Muthathi around 4 pm.

After offering prayers, the family went to the nearby Cauvery River. Police said the group entered the water believing it to be shallow, despite warnings from Home Guards stationed at the spot.

Mandya Superintendent of Police Shobha Rani said the family was taking photographs in the river when they ventured into a deeper section without realising the strength of the underwater currents.

"The water was only knee-deep near the edge. They moved further into the river, underestimating the depth and current," she said.

According to the police, Vijayamma was the first to slip into a deeper portion of the river and began struggling in the current. Chaitra and other family members rushed to rescue her, but they too were caught in the strong flow and were swept away.

Another family member, Ravi, also attempted a rescue but was pulled to safety by local residents. The four-year-old child escaped unharmed.

Fire and Emergency Services personnel, assisted by local residents, immediately launched a search and rescue operation. All five bodies were recovered by around 7.30 pm.

The bodies were shifted to Mandya Institute of Medical Sciences (MIMS) Hospital for post-mortem examination.

Halagur police have registered a case and initiated an investigation into the incident.

The tragedy has once again highlighted the dangers posed by deceptive depths and strong currents in the Cauvery River, particularly during the monsoon season.

#Mandya #Karnataka #CauveryRiver #Muthathi #Drowning

articles.title: Car Blown Up During Muharram Procession in Ujjain Sparks Controversy, Police Launch Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing a car being blown up during a Muharram procession in Madhya Pradesh's Ujjain district has gone viral, triggering controversy and prompting a police investigation.

body.html:
A video showing a car being blown up during a Muharram procession in Madhya Pradesh's Ujjain district has gone viral, triggering controversy and prompting a police investigation.

The incident reportedly took place on the night of June 23 in Badnagar town near Ujjain during a Muharram procession that drew a large crowd.

According to local reports, the procession began from the Adan Mohalla area. During the event, organisers allegedly suspended a car nearly 40 feet in the air using a crane before detonating explosives placed inside the vehicle.

Videos and photographs of the explosion soon surfaced on social media, drawing criticism and raising questions about how such a public display involving explosives was permitted.

The viral footage shows a massive explosion engulfing the suspended vehicle as hundreds of spectators watched from nearby. In some clips, two individuals can also be seen waving red flags moments before the blast.

The controversy intensified after reports emerged that the car carried the slogan "Le Phir Aa Gaye" (We Have Returned Again) before it was blown up. Posters of the Sher-e-Adan Akhada Badnagar were also reportedly displayed during the procession.

Following the circulation of the videos, several social media users and local leaders demanded action. Ujjain-based Hindu Jagran Manch leader Ritesh Maheshwari raised objections to the display, while Haridwar seer Swami Shivanand Giri also criticised the incident and questioned how permission was granted.

Police said they have taken cognisance of the viral videos and initiated an inquiry into the matter.

Badnagar Police Station in-charge Kamlesh Singar said authorities have gathered preliminary information and are questioning the organisers.

"The organisers are being questioned and appropriate action will be taken after the investigation," he said.

Investigators are also examining videos uploaded on social media that allegedly show similar stunts and explosive displays during Muharram-related events.

Police are verifying whether the blast involved licensed fireworks or any other explosive material and whether all necessary permissions had been obtained.

Authorities are expected to issue a detailed statement after completing the inquiry.

#Ujjain #Badnagar #Muharram #MadhyaPradesh #ViralVideo

articles.title: Ice Cream Craving Ends in Hospital: Man Falls From Balcony While Trying to Buy Treat in UP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man sustained injuries after falling from the balcony of his house while attempting to buy ice cream from a street vendor in Uttar Pradesh's Sonbhadra district.

body.html:
A man sustained injuries after falling from the balcony of his house while attempting to buy ice cream from a street vendor in Uttar Pradesh's Sonbhadra district.

The incident, which was captured on CCTV and has since gone viral on social media, occurred when the man spotted an ice cream vendor passing by his house and decided to make a purchase.

According to reports, the man was standing on the first-floor balcony when he called the vendor over and placed an order. Instead of coming downstairs, he allegedly asked the vendor to hand over the ice cream from the road below.

As the vendor stretched upwards to pass the ice cream and the man leaned over the balcony railing to receive it, he reportedly lost his balance and fell directly onto the ground.

The sudden fall caused panic in the area, with family members and local residents rushing to assist him immediately after the incident.

The injured man was taken to a nearby hospital for treatment and is currently undergoing medical care. Police said his condition is stable.

Responding to the viral CCTV footage, Sonbhadra Police stated that the injured individual is receiving treatment and that there are no law-and-order concerns related to the incident.

"What is seen in the viral video is an accidental fall. The injured person is undergoing treatment at the hospital. The situation is normal and there is no law-and-order issue," police said.

The incident serves as a reminder of the risks associated with leaning over balconies and attempting to receive items from a height without proper safety precautions.

#Sonbhadra #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #CCTV #Accident
